targets.name: Kodiak Butte Delta Remnant
targets.description: Isolated erosional remnant exhibiting textbook Gilbert-type delta bottomsets and foresets. Highest priority evidence of ancient high-energy lake stage.
targets.dataSource: NASA Perseverance Rover Mastcam-Z Long Distance Imaging & CRISM

targets.name: South Séítah Cumulate Outcrop
targets.description: Coarse-grained olivine cumulate rock representing planetary magma ocean or thick layered intrusion. Key for radiometric dating of Jezero basin floor.
targets.dataSource: NASA Mars 2020 PIXL / SHERLOC Elemental Core Sample 'Dourbes'

targets.name: Belva Crater Impact Rim & Ejecta
targets.description: Younger impact into delta deposit exposing 3D cross-sections of sedimentary beds and deep megabreccia blocks.

targets.name: Neretva Vallis Inflow Channel Breach
targets.description: Channel canyon through which violent catastrophic floods carved the Jezero crater rim and deposited boulder conglomerates.
targets.dataSource: NASA MGS MOLA & Mars Express HRSC Elevation Surveys

targets.name: Vera Rubin Ridge (Hematite Crest)
targets.description: Narrow topographic ridge rich in crystalline hematite, indicating an ancient redox interface where groundwater met lake water.
targets.dataSource: NASA MSL Curiosity CheMin XRD & APXS Analysis

targets.name: Greenheugh Pediment Unconformity
targets.description: Major regional angular unconformity separating ancient wet lake mudstones from younger wind-blown Stimson sandstones.
targets.dataSource: NASA MSL Curiosity Mastcam Gigapixel Panorama

geology.siteName: Jezero Crater Western Fan (Octavia E. Butler Landing)
geology.stratigraphicContext: Gilbert-type delta foreset/bottomset succession overlying olivine floor unit
geology.mineralogyContext: Fe/Mg smectite clays, magnesium carbonates, olivine phenocrysts (CRISM/PIXL)
geology.thermalInertiaContext: Bedrock outcrops ~450 J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2; sand dunes ~180 J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2
geology.iceResourceProspects: Low direct near-surface ice; high potential for clay mineral structural bound water
geology.dataSourceAttribution: NASA Mars 2020 Mission Archive & MGS MOLA MEGDR
